pitch_detail.notes: Stem the 6' wide chimney 40' before it narrows; clip a bolt at a constriction and traverse up-right 25' through broken ledges to a bolted belay midway across the face.

pitch_detail.belay: Anchor built in the corner at a short finger crack, after the rightward traverse.
pitch_detail.notes: Traverse right another 25' to a short finger crack in the corner and build an anchor.

pitch_detail.belay: Belay sits behind a large chockstone, reached after the corner chimney and a sandy ledge.
pitch_detail.notes: Climb the corner chimney system, passing a sandy ledge, then behind a large chockstone to a belay. Beware of potential rockfall.
Traverse right onto the Quarry Wall, passing 4 bolts before scrambling to the top. A pleasant, clean pitch.

gear: Standard double rack of cams covers most of the pro
Triples in the 0.75-inch cam size are worth carrying for the cruxy second pitch
Pitch 1 climbs a 6-foot-wide chimney for 40 feet before narrowing, with a bolted belay reached via a broken-ledge traverse
A section of pitch 1 (and at least one of its bolts) collapsed in a 2013 rockfall, so don't count on the original bolt count matching older topos
